AboutPage.heroDescr: Swagger Editor App is the RS School graduation project — a full-featured Swagger/OpenAPI editor with an interactive viewer, API request execution and analytics, built with Next.js, React and TypeScript.
AboutPage.schoolTitle: RS School React Course Graduation Project
AboutPage.schoolDescr: This application was created as the final team project during the <course>RS School React course</course>. Our goal was to build a modern developer tool with an intuitive interface for working with OpenAPI specifications.

About.courseText: This application was created as part of the React course.
